purpose: Takes a signed listing from the authorized user's signature to a live, marketed listing: photography, description, compliance check, MLS record, and marketing held for release.
starts: The authorized user signs the listing package (property data, list price, go-live) to Agent 05.
ends: Agent 05 records the listing as active.

steps.text: Signs the listing package: the property data and the list price, decided before this playbook starts.
Checks the package field by field and orders photography from Agent 09.
Picks a photographer from the approved roster with current credentials, puts the appointment on the calendar (Agent 18), and prepares the booking message.
Holds the booking message: it goes to an outside vendor.
Releases the booking.
The photographer delivers the photos.
Counts the delivery only with proof, and passes the photos to Agent 05.
Sends the listing data to Agent 04.
Drafts the description from the property data only and sends it to Compliance.
Checks it against the signed rules: approved or flagged. A flagged draft stops the marketing path.
Releases the approved description to Agents 05 and 12.
Sets the listing active and tells Agent 11 (the seller is told, with consent), Agent 12, Agent 14, and the agents that need listing data (01, 06, 10, 13).
Prepares the listing's publication now that the MLS entry is confirmed (Clear Cooperation).
Holds the publication: it goes to the public.
Releases the publication when ready.

user_decides: The list price and the property data.
Releasing the photographer's booking.
Releasing the publication.
Any conflict between the photos and the data.
never: Change the price.
Publish before the MLS entry is confirmed and the authorized user releases it.
Describe a feature that is not in the data.
run_note: In the recorded run the publication is still held at the end, as it should be: the run ends when the listing is active, and the release is the authorized user's next act.
not_built: No MLS or portal is connected: "active" is Agent 05's own record.

purpose: Carries out a price change the authorized user decided: the record, the seller's notice, buyers' matches and marketing all follow the new price.
starts: The authorized user signs a price change to Agent 05.
ends: Agent 05 records the change.

steps.text: Signs the new price. The decision is made before this playbook starts; nothing in it produces or suggests a number.
Records the new price exactly as signed.
Tells Agent 11 (the seller is told, with consent), Agent 12 and Agent 14.
Sends the new listing data to Agents 13 and 10.
Matches the listing again: a buyer whose budget now fits is matched; a buyer already matched is not matched twice.

user_decides: The price.
Any change to marketing that names a price.
never: Produce, suggest or change a price.
run_note: In the recorded run the listing goes from 450,000 to 440,000. A buyer with a 445,000 budget is matched only after the drop; a buyer matched before is not matched again. The ad carries no price, so the authorized user is not asked about it.
not_built: No MLS or portal is connected.

purpose: Moves an accepted offer into transaction mode: the listing goes pending, marketing stops, and the contract's timeline starts.
starts: The authorized user signs the listing's change to pending, with the executed contract on file.
ends: The authorized user signs the contract's timeline to Agent 07; Contract to Close (P09) starts on it.

steps.text: The executed contract arrives; Agent 11 passes it to Agent 08, which checks and files it and tells Agent 07.
Signs the status change to pending, naming the filed contract.
Sets the listing pending and tells Agents 11 (the seller is told), 12, 14, 06 and 01.
An ad still held for release is now for a pending listing: it asks the authorized user to decline it.
Signs the contract's dates (inspection, appraisal, financing, closing) to Agent 07.
Puts each deadline on the calendar (Agent 18) and asks Agent 08 for each document.
Asks the parties for the documents through Agent 11.
Asks Agent 09 for the inspector and the appraiser.
Books from the approved roster; with no approved vendor of that kind it books nothing and asks the authorized user.

user_decides: The status change and the contract.
The contract's dates.
Declining an ad that would publish a pending listing.
Choosing a vendor when the roster has none.
never: Calculate contract dates.
Book a vendor who is not on the roster.
run_note: In the recorded run no inspector or appraiser is on the roster, so Agent 09 asks the authorized user both times: "urgency does not create approval".

purpose: Runs an open house on a live listing: the calendar, the vendors, the visitors who become leads, and the result.
starts: The authorized user signs the open house's start and end to Agent 06.
ends: The authorized user signs the open house result (attendance and feedback) to Agent 06.

steps.text: Signs the open house time.
Puts it on the calendar (Agent 18) and asks Agent 09 for what the open house needs (for example signage).
Books from the approved roster, or asks the authorized user when the roster has none.
A visitor leaves their details: an inquiry to Agent 01, which runs Speed to Lead (P11) for that visitor.
Signs the result: attendance and the feedback heard.
Logs the result to Agent 14.

user_decides: The time.
Vendors when the roster has none.
Calling a visitor who scores hot.
never: Book a vendor who is not on the roster.
run_note: In the recorded run a visitor with consent, pre-approval and a 30-day timeline scores hot and the authorized user is alerted; no signage vendor is on the roster, so Agent 09 asks.

purpose: Winds down an expired or withdrawn listing: marketing stops at once and everyone is told.
starts: The authorized user signs the listing's status as withdrawn or expired.
ends: Agent 05 records the status.

steps.text: Signs the status change, naming the seller's confirmation.
Sets the status and tells Agents 11 (the seller is told), 12, 14, 06 and 01.
Stops all marketing for the listing. An ad still held for release would now publish a withdrawn listing: it asks the authorized user to decline it.

user_decides: The status change.
Declining any held ad.
never: Publish anything for a listing that is no longer on the market.
run_note: In the recorded run the listing's launch ad is still held when it is withdrawn; Agent 12 asks the authorized user to decline it.

purpose: Starts a buyer's search: criteria recorded exactly as stated, matches held until the written buyer agreement is on file, then sent.
starts: The authorized user signs the buyer's first criteria to Agent 13.
ends: The first match is sent to the buyer.

steps.text: Signs the buyer's criteria, word for word.
Matches new listings against them.
No written buyer agreement on file: the matches are held and the authorized user is told once.
Records the signed buyer agreement with Agent 14.
On the next daily run, the held matches go out.
Sends the match through Agent 11 (with consent) and logs it to Agent 14.

user_decides: The buyer agreement.
The buyer's criteria, as stated.
never: Add or infer a criterion.
Send a match before the buyer agreement is on file.
run_note: In the recorded run a new listing fits the buyer before the agreement is recorded; the match is held, and goes out on the clock run after the agreement is recorded.

purpose: Coordinates a showing from the buyer's request to logged feedback.
starts: A showing request reaches Agent 06 (from Agent 13 on a match, or from the buyer through Agent 11).
ends: The buyer's feedback is logged; Buyer Feedback and Match Refresh (P22) starts on it.

steps.text: The buyer asks to see a home.
Passes the request to Agent 06.
Checks the buyer agreement, the requester's identity, the notice period, the listing's status and clashes (see Agent 06).
Puts the showing on the calendar (Agent 18). If the calendar cannot take it, the showing is held for the authorized user.
Confirms the showing to the buyer through Agent 11.
The day after, asks the buyer for feedback through Agent 11.
The buyer answers.
Passes the feedback to Agent 06, which logs it to Agent 14.

user_decides: A showing the calendar could not take.
Clashes.
never: Confirm a showing without the buyer agreement.
Authorize access to a property.
run_note: In the recorded run the buyer asks for 10:00, the showing is confirmed, feedback is asked the next day and logged.
not_built: Seller availability is not checked (there is no seller availability data).

purpose: Tracks an offer from receipt to its outcome. The thinnest playbook on purpose: the negotiation is entirely the authorized user's.
starts: The authorized user records an offer's status with Agent 07.
ends: The authorized user records the offer's outcome.

steps.text: Records the offer received, with its document.
Reports the status to the authorized user only, never to a client.
Negotiates: presenting, countering, accepting or rejecting is outside the system.
Records the outcome.
Reports it to the authorized user. An accepted offer leads to Under-Contract Transition (P03).

user_decides: Everything about the offer.
never: Negotiate.
Tell a client about an offer's status.
run_note: In the recorded run an offer is received and then rejected; both updates go to the authorized user, none to a client.
not_built: An offer's response deadline is stored with its status, but nothing alerts on it.

purpose: Runs the contract to closing: every deadline watched, every document checked, and the close held if something is missing.
starts: The authorized user signs the contract's timeline to Agent 07.
ends: Agent 07 reports the transaction closed; Close and Post-Close Handoff (P10) starts on it.

steps.text: Signs the contract's dates, and lists the expected senders for sensitive documents (for example the title company for the settlement statement).
Puts each deadline on the calendar and asks Agent 08 for each document.
Asks the parties through Agent 11; chases daily; raises a document still missing after three chases.
Asks Agent 09 for the inspector; with no approved vendor, Agent 09 asks the authorized user.
Documents arrive.
Files a document only from an expected sender and only if it opens; tells Agent 07.
A deadline counts as met only with its document on file. Anything unmet at closing is held for the authorized user.
Decides whether the close continues.
Reports the transaction closed to Agents 14, 15 and 16.

user_decides: The dates and the expected senders.
Whether to continue with something unmet.
Every movement of money and every wire instruction.
never: File a document from an unexpected sender.
Mark a deadline met on someone's word.
Move money.
run_note: In the recorded run the settlement statement arrives from the listed title company and is filed; the inspection report never came, so the close waits for the authorized user and continues on the signed decision.
not_built: No date arithmetic; warnings ahead of a due date (except the seller disclosure).

purpose: Hands a closed deal over to the relationship: the commission recorded, the client record updated, and the follow-up schedule started.
starts: Agent 07 reports the transaction closed.
ends: The first post-close check-in is sent (or blocked with the reason).

steps.text: Reports the close to Agents 16, 14 and 15.
Records the commission.
Updates the client record.
Schedules the check-ins at 30, 90 and 365 days for a client on the authorized user's list.
On the 30th day the check-in is due.
Checks opt-out, hard times on record and a working contact; sends through Agent 11, which checks consent.

user_decides: The client list.
Whether to reach out during a hard time.
never: Contact someone who is not on the list or who opted out.
run_note: In the recorded run the deal closes and the 30-day check-in goes out on the clock.
not_built: Maintenance tips and a self-running referral schedule.

purpose: Turns any inquiry into a scored, routed lead within minutes.
starts: An inquiry reaches Agent 01 (a call, form or text, or a social media lead from Agent 20).
ends: Agent 02 has scored and routed the lead.

steps.text: Someone reaches out.
Records what they said and their consent, nothing guessed.
Asks Agent 14 whether they are already on record; a possible duplicate is held for the authorized user.
Scores the lead on the signed rubric.
Hot: alerts the authorized user (marked do not contact where that applies). Warm: to Agent 03. Cold: archived with the reason.
For a warm lead, starts the sequence the authorized user wrote; its text goes to Compliance first.

user_decides: Calling the hot lead.
Whether a possible duplicate is the same person.
never: Score a lead before the duplicate check.
Contact anyone without consent.
run_note: In the recorded run a web form lead with a 60-day timeline scores warm and goes to nurture; the sequence's text is checked by Compliance.
not_built: No phone, form or text system is connected.
A second alert when a hot lead is not acknowledged in time.

purpose: Runs a farm campaign (general marketing to an area) the authorized user decided on.
starts: The authorized user signs a new campaign (copy, area, targeting) to Agent 12.
ends: The campaign is published.

steps.text: Signs the campaign: the copy, the area and the budget.
Checks the targeting: general, by area; no demographic targeting; housing ad rules apply.
Checks the copy against the signed rules.
Holds the publication.
Releases it.

user_decides: The campaign, its area and budget.
Releasing the publication.
never: Target individual households or demographics.
Solicit owners whose homes are listed with another broker.
run_note: In the recorded run a market update for zip code 44101 is approved, held and published on release.
not_built: No social or ad platform is connected.

purpose: Keeps the relationship going with past clients: greetings and anniversaries from the authorized user's list.
starts: Agent 14 sends a date reminder (birthday, anniversary) to Agent 16.
ends: The greeting is sent, or blocked with the reason.

steps.text: On the date, sends the reminder for a person on the authorized user's client list.
Checks opt-out, hard times and a working contact.
Sends the greeting through Agent 11, which checks consent.

user_decides: The client list and the dates.
Whether to reach out during a hard time.
never: Greet someone who is not on the list.
Offer a referral reward.
run_note: In the recorded run a client's birthday greeting goes out on the day.

purpose: Handles a complaint: the authorized user is alerted, every message to that person stops, and the response is the authorized user's.
starts: A complaint arrives (from social media through Agent 20, or from a client through Agent 11).
ends: The authorized user lifts the complaint hold.

steps.text: Raises a complaint alert for the authorized user with the words, and asks Agent 11 to hold messages to that person.
Holds every routine message to that person; each one is logged, none sent.
Responds to the complaint, personally.
Lifts the hold.

user_decides: The whole response.
When the hold ends.
never: Reply to a complaint automatically.
Send routine messages to someone who complained, while the hold is on.
run_note: In the recorded run a routine feedback request to the same person arrives during the hold and is not sent; the run ends when the authorized user lifts the hold.

purpose: Prepares the data for a listing appointment. The price opinion is the authorized user's.
starts: The authorized user asks Agent 10 for comparables on a home that is not one of the office's live listings.
ends: Agent 10 delivers the package.

steps.text: Asks for comparables for the appointment.
Checks each figure for a source, a date and freshness; checks there are enough comparables.
Delivers the package to the authorized user, with no opinion or value.

user_decides: The price opinion and the presentation.
never: Suggest a price.
run_note: In the recorded run five sourced comparables are delivered.
not_built: No MLS data source is connected; the figures come with the request.

purpose: Builds the morning briefing from the record.
starts: The morning clock: Agent 18 asks for the first section.
ends: Agent 18 sends the briefing to the authorized user.

steps.text: The morning run starts.
Asks Agent 14 for overnight leads, Agent 15 for yesterday's books, Agent 19 for prospects waiting and Agent 10 for market changes.
Adds the calendar, open waits, decisions pending and deadlines; a section with no answer is named as missing.
Sends one briefing to the authorized user.

user_decides: The day's priorities.
never: Put an unsourced status in the briefing.
run_note: In the recorded run all four sections answer and one briefing is sent.

purpose: Closes the day's books into one report.
starts: The evening clock: Agent 14 sends its end-of-day books to Agent 15.
ends: Agent 15 sends one report to the authorized user.

steps.text: The evening run starts.
Sends the day's records to Agent 15.
Adds the day's commissions and expenses and sends one report to the authorized user.

user_decides: Nothing required; the report is for reading.
never: Mix estimates with recorded figures.
run_note: In the recorded run the evening clock produces one report.

purpose: The seller's weekly update: counted from the record, held for the authorized user, then sent.
starts: On the authorized user's signed weekday, Agent 06 prepares each listing's report.
ends: The report is sent to the seller (or skipped, with the reason).

steps.text: Sets the weekday and the listings to report on.
On that weekday the daily run starts.
Counts the week's showings and feedback for each listing and holds the report for the authorized user.
Continues (send) or cancels.
On continue, sends it through Agent 11 (with consent). Numbers only.

user_decides: Whether each report goes.
never: Send a report the authorized user did not continue.
Add opinion or advice.
run_note: In the recorded run the report is held, continued by the authorized user and sent to the seller.
not_built: Market movement is not in the report: showings and feedback counts only.

purpose: Keeps property access (keys, codes, lockboxes) as custody items: who has access, until when, never the code itself.
starts: The authorized user signs an access grant to Agent 14.
ends: The authorized user signs the grant closed.

steps.text: Signs the grant: the party, the end of the window, the custody reference (never the code).
Records it; a window that ends without being closed is flagged once.
Closes the grant.

user_decides: Every grant and every closing.
never: Send an access code or key in a message.
run_note: In the recorded run an inspector's lockbox access is granted and closed.
not_built: Rotating codes and auditing custody on a schedule.

purpose: Watches a vacant listing: a condition check every day until it is occupied or the listing ends.
starts: Agent 05 records the listing as vacant.
ends: Agent 05 records the watch ended (occupied, or the listing ended).

steps.text: Marks the listing vacant.
Each daily run, Agent 05 orders a condition check from Agent 09 (no new one while the last is open).
Books it from the roster; the booking waits for release; a check counts only with proof.
Marks the listing occupied (or the listing ends).
Ends the watch.

user_decides: Vacant or occupied.
Releasing each booking.
never: Count a check without proof.
run_note: In the recorded run the listing is marked vacant, a check is ordered on the clock, and the watch ends when it is marked occupied.

purpose: Re-scores nurtured leads every week so a warming lead is not left to go cold.
starts: Agent 03 sends a lead back to Agent 02 for a new score.
ends: Agent 02 has scored and routed it.

steps.text: Every 7 days, for each warm lead in nurture.
Sends it to Agent 02 with its stated timeline counted down by the days passed.
Scores it again: hot to the authorized user, still warm back to nurture, otherwise out of the pool.

user_decides: Calling a lead that turns hot.
never: Re-score an opted-out lead or a paused sequence.
run_note: In the recorded run the lead is still warm a week later and returns to nurture.

purpose: Turns a buyer's feedback after a tour into the next round of matches.
starts: The buyer's feedback is logged (the end of Tour Day, P07).
ends: The next match is sent to the buyer.

steps.text: Logs the buyer's feedback.
Updates the criteria only from the buyer's explicit words.
Matches new listings and sends the next match through Agent 11.

user_decides: Anything in the feedback that reads as a discriminatory preference (it is never turned into a criterion).
When the buyer wants to make an offer (Offer to Acceptance, P08).
never: Turn an impression into a criterion.
run_note: In the recorded run the buyer's feedback opens the refresh; the next listing that fits closes it.

purpose: Assembles the evidence for a price conversation on a live listing. It never produces a number.
starts: The authorized user asks Agent 10 for comparables on one of the office's live listings.
ends: Agent 10 delivers the package.

steps.text: Asks for the evidence.
Checks each figure for a source, a date and freshness.
Delivers the package with no recommended price and no "should reduce" language.
Decides. A change is a new signed price, which starts Price Adjustment (P02).

user_decides: Whether to talk price, and the price.
never: Suggest a price or a reduction.
run_note: In the recorded run the package is delivered to the authorized user.
not_built: The automatic signals (days on market, showing-to-offer ratio) that would start it; the authorized user starts it.

purpose: Puts prospecting opportunities in front of the authorized user. Every case is the authorized user's decision; nobody is contacted by the system.
starts: A discovery feed record reaches Agent 19.
ends: The prospect reaches the authorized user (or is recorded as suppressed by rule).

steps.text: A feed record arrives.
Keeps it only if it is in the monitored zip codes and from an approved source.
Records representation and Do Not Call status, and asks Agent 10 for market data.
Passes the prospect to the authorized user, with a legal-line alert first for an expired listing or a sale by owner.
Decides whether and how to reach out.

user_decides: Every outreach.
never: Contact a prospect.
Use a source that is not approved.
run_note: In the recorded run a new listing from the approved feed in 44101 reaches the authorized user with its market data.
